title: Paid time off
summary: How annual leave is accrued, requested, and approved.
body: Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual leave per calendar year. Submit requests at least two weeks ahead when possible. Your manager approves requests in PeopleHub, and unused days follow the carryover rules in your employment agreement.

title: Parental leave
summary: Support for growing families and new caregivers.
body: PeopleHub provides paid parental leave for birth, adoption, and foster placement. Contact your People Partner to confirm eligibility, plan your leave dates, and coordinate benefits continuation.

title: Flexible work
summary: Guidelines for working across office and remote locations.
body: Teams align on a shared collaboration rhythm, with flexibility for focused remote work. Keep your calendar current, protect team overlap hours, and discuss recurring location changes with your manager.

title: Expense reimbursement
summary: Submitting business expenses clearly and on time.
body: Submit itemized receipts within 30 days through the Finance portal. Expenses must have a business purpose and manager approval. Mileage and travel follow the current rate schedule.

title: Code of conduct
summary: The standards that keep PeopleHub respectful and inclusive.
body: We expect thoughtful, inclusive behavior in every interaction. Report concerns to your manager, People Partner, or the confidential reporting channel. Retaliation for raising a concern is not tolerated.
